policy.source_unit: One original event or authored document; multiple clips from one event are grouped.
policy.behavioral_observation: unknown; no gesture, expression, timing, or personality measurements inferred from text
policy.predictions: Historical plans and assertions, not verified outcomes or present-day views.

sources.date_basis: The official clip pages each display October 8, 2003.
sources.text_access: Three official clip transcripts read; not the complete event transcript.
sources.speaker_attribution: Musk only; business-education and cost explanations are answers within the event.
sources.video_url_basis: Career Development clip's embedded YouTube player; other clips have distinct timelines.
sources.timing: Clip labels only. No timestamps inferred from prose or treated as full-event offsets.

sources.date_basis: Release day is August 12, 2013; the primary PDF itself is undated. The contemporaneous AllThingsD publication documents the release.
sources.text_access: Official Tesla PDF, printed pages 1–4 read for the selected evidence.
sources.speaker_attribution: First-person introduction by Musk; technical development credited to Tesla and SpaceX colleagues.
sources.timing: Printed document pages; no audio/video alignment.

sources.date_basis: MIT News publication date October 25, 2014; exact interview recording date is not assigned.
sources.text_access: Event host's original report, Musk–Peraire section only; not a full transcript.
sources.speaker_attribution: Only remarks explicitly attributed to Musk; comments from astronauts and other panelists excluded.
sources.timing: Article section labels; no measured media timestamps.

sources.date_basis: March 5, 2014 is printed on the statement and confirmed by the official hearing schedule.
sources.text_access: Official prepared statement read. Later requests intermittently returned HTTP 403. The same statement was independently verified in the official GPO hearing transcript.
sources.speaker_attribution: Musk's prepared statement only; other witnesses and oral exchanges excluded.
sources.timing: Document section locators; not a hearing recording timeline.

sources.date_basis: January 18, 2019 is printed in SEC exhibit 99.1.
sources.text_access: Complete public exhibit read; only short paraphrases distributed.
sources.speaker_attribution: Employee message signed Elon, reproduced by Tesla in a public filing.
sources.timing: Document paragraph locators; no audiovisual source.

sources.date_basis: Public hearing on March 18, 2004. The later written answers have no exact submission date in the selected record and are labeled accordingly.
sources.text_access: Musk's oral statement and answers to post-hearing question 1a read in the official GPO transcript.
sources.speaker_attribution: Only Mr. Musk's statement and the explicitly labeled Responses by Elon Musk. Other witnesses' answers excluded.
sources.question_context: Statement concerns interagency launch cooperation; later written question asks which regulations SpaceX found burdensome.
sources.timing: Oral and post-hearing written material use distinct section timelines; no audiovisual alignment.

sources.date_basis: Public hearing on May 5, 2004. GPO republication date is shown only as the year 2016; that is not substituted for the event date.
sources.text_access: Musk's oral statement read in the official GPO transcript.
sources.speaker_attribution: Musk only. Committee disagreement about a procurement protest is context, not evidence of a general behavioral trait.
sources.question_context: The chair requested remarks on launch capacity and ISS support; the selected records come from the ensuing statement.
sources.timing: Hearing section locators; no measured recording timestamps.

sources.date_basis: Public hearing April 20, 2005; GPO volume printed in 2005.
sources.text_access: Musk's Panel II opening statement read in the official transcript.
sources.speaker_attribution: Only Musk's identified statement. The adjacent panel's discussion of learning from failed experiments belongs to Burt Rutan and is not attributed to Musk.
sources.question_context: Prepared responses about SpaceX's business plan, government support, and implications of exploration goals.
sources.timing: Section labels, not media offsets. Planned Falcon V features remain plans at the date of testimony.

sources.date_basis: Public hearing March 7, 2007; GPO volume printed in 2007.
sources.text_access: Musk's oral statement read in the official transcript.
sources.speaker_attribution: Musk speaking as Tesla chairman; adjacent statements by Google and financial-sector witnesses excluded.
sources.question_context: How to accelerate commercialization and investment in advanced energy technologies.
sources.timing: Statement section locators; no measured recording timestamps.

sources.date_basis: Public hearing October 26, 2011; the transcript volume was printed in 2012.
sources.text_access: Musk's opening oral statement read in the official transcript.
sources.speaker_attribution: Only Musk's identified statement; no NASA or competing-company testimony attributed to him.
sources.question_context: Progress and constraints in commercial crew development; the selected material is an opening statement, not later Q&A.
sources.timing: Statement section locators. The transcript marks a video playback but supplies no shared media clock.

sources.date_basis: Original post byline dated August 13, 2018; court exhibit preserves an April 5, 2021 webpage capture.
sources.text_access: Both pages of original blog post as preserved in public trial exhibit 53 read.
sources.speaker_attribution: Musk's bylined public explanation in his explicitly stated capacity as a potential bidder.
sources.context_limit: This establishes what he publicly said, not the truth of financing claims or a legal conclusion. No private email addresses or court-party personal details included.
sources.timing: Court exhibit pages; no audiovisual source.

sources.date_basis: February 19, 2014 is printed on the shareholder letter; 2013 in the title is the reporting period.
sources.text_access: Corporate letter body and its two signatories verified in SEC exhibit 99.1.
sources.speaker_attribution: Co-signed by Elon Musk and Deepak Ahuja. All selected evidence explicitly preserves shared corporate authorship.
sources.context_limit: Supports corporate strategy he signed, not individual spontaneous speech, private belief, or verified present-day product claims.
sources.timing: Document section labels; no audio/video alignment.

validation.schema: All 12 Source and 71 Evidence records validated with the repository's Pydantic models.
validation.integrity: Unique source/evidence IDs; all source references resolve; no source-ID or canonical-URL overlap with the original seven-source corpus or expansion A.
validation.evidence_range: Each source has 4–7 records and fewer than 180 evidence words.
validation.gesture_and_time: All behavioral_observation fields are null; no numeric media timestamps invented.
validation.accuracy_scope: Manual source-grounding review plus structural checks, not an independent factual audit or persona-fidelity benchmark.

coverage_limits: The batch is concentrated in engineering, company strategy, and public testimony from 2003–2019; it does not represent every aspect or period of Musk's public persona.
Six congressional events contain advocacy by an interested business participant. These statements must remain attributed and dated.
No source in this batch supports visual, vocal, emotional, or psychological measurements.
The MIT record is a host's excerpted report. The Tesla 2014 letter is coauthored. These are weaker evidence of spontaneous personal phrasing than a directly attributed full interview.
Source dates use first public delivery for hearings; later official republication years and undated post-hearing answers are disclosed separately.

excluded_or_pending.reason: Observed URLs redirect to a generic blog index. The original article body was not available through these URLs. No evidence records created.
Original transcript link returned 404. Event metadata alone does not establish speech content. No evidence records created.
A short original host report is accessible, but it provides too little directly attributed content for this batch's source coverage target. It is not counted as an acquired full speech.
Official USC video and May 16, 2014 event date verified. Only third-party transcript bodies were retrieved; no transcript-derived evidence is included in this batch.
Original short message verified in SEC filing, but not padded into four separate claims or counted in the acquired-source total.
